question: What is the value of {1+xover1-{x²}}div{1+xover1-{x⁴}}-{1-x⁴over1-{x}}times{(1+x)over1-{x²}}
solution:
**Given:**

(1+x)/(1-x²)div (1+x)/(1-x⁴)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+
x)/(1-x²)

**Calculation:**

(1+x)/(1-x²)div (1+x)/(1-x⁴)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)

**(1+x)/(1-x²)times (1-x⁴)/(1+x)-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)**

1+x²-(1-x⁴)/(1-x)times (1+x)/(1-x²)

1+x²-{1+x²}times (1+x)/(1-x)

(1-x+x²-x³-1-x-x²-x³)/(1-x)

{2x(1+x²)}over{(x-1)}

 

**Therefore, the value of the given expression is {2x(1+x²)}over{(x-1)}.**
